reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 editorial pass over all 36 original exercises: read and solved each complete German sentence without relying solely on its key; evaluated every one of four offered options, grammar, verb sense, target level, bilingual instructions, hints and explanations, and differences between the two contexts. Revised 30 prompts/option sets to strengthen semantic distractors and remove competing interpretations. Authored 18 sources; deferred aufwachen and ausdrucken because inherited B1 placement needs review. Corrected inherited ausfallen ('to sortie' is not the chosen sense) and ausnehmen ('excluding' gloss). CEFR labels are inherited claims, not certified levels. All targets remain pending, publicationApproved=false. Structural CI cannot establish independent linguistic approval, rights clearance or learner transfer.
